Title: Save and Discard buttons are not visible in forms
Description: The Save and Discard buttons are not visible by default in any form.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open any form.
2. Observe the available action buttons.
3. Click the Close button.
Actual Result: The Save and Discard buttons appear only after clicking the Close button.
Expected Result: The Save and Discard buttons should be displayed appropriately whenever a form contains changes that need to be saved or discarded.

Title: Backend integration is missing
Description: Application functionality appears to be handled entirely on the UI, with no backend integration.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the application.
2. Change data in any module.
3. Refresh or reopen the page and inspect persistence.
Actual Result: Changes and data are handled only on the UI and are not persisted or reflected through backend services.
Expected Result: All relevant functionalities should be integrated with the backend, and data should be saved, retrieved, and updated correctly.
Notes: As reported; broad cross-module issue. Needs investigation with backend/API logs.

Title: OmniEye logo/icon is not clickable
Description: The OmniEye icon in the top-left corner of the header is not working.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the application.
2. Click the OmniEye icon in the top-left corner.
Actual Result: Nothing happens after clicking the icon.
Expected Result: The icon should perform its intended action, such as navigating to the default dashboard or home page.

Title: Sidebar open/close button is not user-friendly
Description: The sidebar open/close button is not intuitive or user-friendly.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Locate the open/close control.
3. Observe its interaction and feedback.
Actual Result: The button's functionality or interaction is not clear to the user.
Expected Result: The button should have a clear visual indication and provide an intuitive way to open and close the sidebar.

Title: Sidebar lock/unlock functionality is not user-friendly
Description: The sidebar lock/unlock functionality is not intuitive.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Locate the lock/unlock control.
3. Attempt to lock and unlock the sidebar.
Actual Result: The lock/unlock interaction is not clear to the user.
Expected Result: The lock/unlock control should clearly indicate the current state and allow users to understand whether the sidebar is locked or unlocked.

Title: Sidebar Menu Item 2 is not clickable
Description: The second menu item in the sidebar is not clickable.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the sidebar.
2. Click the second menu item.
Actual Result: The menu item does not respond to the click.
Expected Result: The menu item should be clickable and navigate to the corresponding page or perform its intended action.

Title: Dashboard preview flickers after opening Theme Studio
Description: The dashboard preview flickers after clicking Theme Studio.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Click Theme Studio.
3. Observe the dashboard preview.
Actual Result: The dashboard preview flickers after opening Theme Studio.
Expected Result: The dashboard preview should load and remain stable without flickering.

Title: Video does not start from the beginning
Description: After a user logs in, the video starts playing or appears at the 23-second mark instead of 00:00.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in to the application.
2. Navigate to the Dashboard.
3. Observe the video playback position.
Actual Result: The video starts or appears at approximately 00:23.
Expected Result: The video should start from 00:00 when playback is initiated for a new session.

Title: Player controls show paused while the preview video is playing
Description: The playback state displayed in the player controls does not match the actual video preview state.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Observe the player controls and the video preview simultaneously.
Actual Result: The player controls indicate that the video is paused, but the preview video continues playing.
Expected Result: The player controls and video preview should always reflect the same playback state.

Title: Video timeline seeking does not work correctly
Description: Seeking to a different timestamp in the video timeline does not correctly update the playback position.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Allow the video to play until approximately 00:07.
3. Seek back to 00:00 using the video timeline.
4. Observe the playback timer and preview.
Actual Result: The video does not restart from 00:00 correctly. The playback timer continues from the previous position, and the preview changes inconsistently.
Expected Result: When a user seeks to 00:00, the video should return to the beginning, and the playback timer and preview should update accordingly.

Title: Playback speed icon does not update
Description: The playback speed control icon does not change appropriately when the user opens the settings menu.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Click the Settings button in the video player.
3. Observe the playback speed control icon.
Actual Result: The playback speed control appears, but the icon does not change as expected.
Expected Result: The playback speed icon should update appropriately to reflect the playback speed control's state or selected option.

Title: Playback speed selection does not affect video speed
Description: Selecting a different playback speed does not change the actual video playback speed.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Click the Settings button.
3. Select a playback speed of 0.25x.
4. Observe the video playback.
Actual Result: The video continues playing at normal speed instead of 0.25x.
Expected Result: The video should play at the selected speed of 0.25x.

Title: Inconsistent scrollbar behavior between Appearance and Brand & Content
Description: The scrollbar visibility changes unexpectedly when navigating between the Appearance and Brand & Content sections.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Theme Studio.
2. Click Appearance.
3. Observe the scrollbar.
4. Click Brand & Content.
5. Observe the scrollbar again.
Actual Result: The scrollbar disappears in the Appearance section but reappears in the Brand & Content section.
Expected Result: Scrollbar behavior should remain consistent across sections and follow the intended UI design.

Title: CC and HD buttons are not working
Description: The CC (Closed Captions) and HD buttons in the video player are not functional.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Dashboard.
2. Click the CC button.
3. Click the HD button.
4. Observe the video player.
Actual Result: Neither button performs its intended action.
Expected Result:
CC: The button should enable or disable closed captions, where supported.
HD: The button should allow users to select or enable the appropriate video quality, where supported.

Title: Save button is missing when adding a user
Description: The Save button is not visible when adding a new user in Report Builder.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Report Builder.
2. Navigate to the Add User section.
3. Enter the required user details.
4. Observe the available action buttons.
Expected Result: A Save button should be available to allow users to save the newly added user's details.

Title: Newly added user does not appear in the user list
Description: A newly added user does not appear in the user list after the save action.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Report Builder.
2. Navigate to Add User.
3. Enter the required user details.
4. Click the Close (X) button.
5. Click Save when the Save and Discard options appear.
6. Check the user list.
Actual Result: The newly added user does not appear in the list. The issue appears to be related to missing backend integration or data persistence.
Expected Result: After successfully saving a new user, the user should appear in the list, and the data should persist when the page is refreshed or reopened.
Notes: As reported; likely related to BUG-002 (backend integration).

Title: Saved current view cannot be accessed or applied
Description: The Save Current View option does not provide a way to access or apply a previously saved view.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Report Builder.
2. Select the Save Current View option.
3. Save the current view.
4. Look for an option to access or apply the saved view.
Actual Result: There is no visible option to select or apply the previously saved view.
Expected Result: Users should be able to access, select, and apply previously saved views through an appropriate interface.

Title: Download theme option does not prompt the user to select a theme
Description: Clicking Download Theme downloads the currently selected theme without prompting the user to confirm or select which theme to download.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Theme Studio.
2. Click Download Theme.
3. Observe the download behavior.
Actual Result: The currently selected theme is downloaded immediately without asking the user which theme they want to download.
Expected Result: The application should provide an appropriate prompt or selection interface that allows the user to choose the theme to download, if multiple themes are available.

Title: Save button is not easily accessible when customizing a theme
Description: When a user customizes a theme, the Save button is located inside Theme Settings > My Theme > Save, making it difficult to access.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Theme Studio.
2. Select a theme.
3. Customize the theme.
4. Look for the Save button.
Actual Result: The Save button is available only under Theme Settings > My Theme > Save.
Expected Result: A Save button should be displayed prominently at the top of the interface when a user modifies or customizes a theme, allowing changes to be saved easily.
